Position Expectations

Accountable for project planning and execution, customer experience, and ensuring MongoDB delivery meets committed scope and budget
Employ project management excellence to navigate with agility the complex organizations of large enterprises, building mindshare to plan and execute programs likely to have ambiguous risks and challenges
Maintain excellence of project governance with internal and customer stakeholders, managing day-to-day project planning and execution, project scope, expectations and risks, and ensuring timelines are met and quality results produced
Lend support to pre-sale engagements to assist with scoping of solution and project scope definition
Adopt and contribute to the continuous improvement of MongoDB's engagement and project delivery methodologies
Confidently lead project meetings, owning meeting agenda and meeting outcomes
Lead the management of scope, change controls, customer expectations and timelines

Measures of Success

Collaborate directly with customers and other internal teams to lead and deliver high-quality, reference-able engagements
Of paramount importance is predictability: of forecasts for resource needs and revenue; of internal & customer stakeholder management; of outcomes; of risk management; of customer expectations and experience
Demonstrate eye for business through robust control of the internal and external budget, project margin, resource utilization and billability across your entire project portfolio

Candidate Profile

University degree or relevant work experience
5+ years proven experience with enterprise-scale software solutions, large scale software engineering or consulting services delivery experience preferred
Demonstrated leadership skills within complex, transformative projects, with direct responsibility for leading project teams, delivering high quality results on schedule and within budget
Comfortable creating plans and priorities for both project delivery and customer resources
Demonstrated belief in the power of stakeholder management and communications; track record of affecting change through stakeholder engagement
Outstanding and effective interpersonal skills; strong verbal and written communication abilities
Consulting and delivery experience serving banking and securities clients in Taiwan is preferred
Certification or deep experience with standard frameworks such as the PMI PMBOK, or Scrum methodologies would be beneficial

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

jobs.title: Global Install Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

As a Global Install IT Project Manager you will be responsible for planning, executing, and delivering IT projects supporting GEHC’s Global Install organization across the AIS (Imaging & AVS) and PCS businesses.

Working closely with business stakeholders, IT Product Managers, engineering teams, and global IT organizations, you will lead project execution for Global Install initiatives from planning through deployment.

In this role you will in charge of project planning, governance, resource coordination, risk and dependency management, and deployment planning to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business priorities.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery

Lead end-to-end execution of Global Install IT projects from initiation through deployment,
Develop and manage project plans, schedules, budgets, resources, milestones, and deliverables,
Monitor project health and proactively manage risks, issues, dependencies, and changes,
Drive projects to completion on time, within scope, and within budget.

Project Governance

Support project governance and provide clear, timely reporting,
Track project milestones, financials, risks, dependencies, and KPIs,
Facilitate project reviews and decision-making forums,
Escalate delivery risks and drive mitigation plans as needed.

Cross-functional Coordination

Partner with IT Product Managers to execute approved initiatives and project priorities,
Coordinate activities across engineering, architecture, cybersecurity, QA, infrastructure, vendors, and other IT teams,
Collaborate with Global and Regional Install teams, Commercial Operations, Field Service, and other stakeholders to coordinate IT delivery supporting customer equipment installations,
Drive resolution of cross-functional dependencies and delivery roadblocks.

Release & Deployment

Coordinate release planning, testing, deployment, and production-readiness,
Coordinate post-go-live stabilization and transition to ongoing support.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Administration, or a related technical field
Progressive experience in IT project management, preferably in healthcare technology, medical device, or complex capital equipment industry.
Proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex installation projects from inception to completion.
PMP or equivalent project management certification is highly preferred.
Strong understanding of medical imaging technologies (e.g., MRI, CT, X-ray) and associated installation requirements.
Excellent leadership, communication (written and verbal), and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively influence and negotiate with diverse stakeholders at all levels.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Proficiency in project management software (e.g., MS Project, Primavera) and Microsoft Office Suite.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and as part of a global team, adapting to different cultural contexts.
Fluent in English; proficiency in additional languages is a plus.

Placement Within This Range Depends On

Relevant skills and qualifications
Prior job-related experience
Internal equity considerations (alignment with colleagues in similar roles) e.t.c.

We review pay ranges regularly to ensure they remain competitive with the external market and align with our internal equity considerations.

In addition to base salary, our employees have access to a comprehensive package of benefits and allowances, which may include:

Health & wellness coverage
Retirement and or savings plans
Allowances or benefits to support role requirements (e.g., mobility, transport, or role-specific needs such as a company car or allowance where applicable)

jobs.title: Project Manager, Exterior Signage
jobs.description:
Ideal Candidate will have previous experience in the Signage Industry

There’s never been a better time to join Stratus! As the market leader in brand implementation and maintenance, we transform how national brands connect with their customers. From exterior signage & interior branding to site refresh & remodel, from energy & lighting to repair & maintenance solutions, we deliver ideal solutions to meet all our client's branding needs.

From our locations across the country, to our corporate headquarters in Mentor, Ohio, every employee is a stakeholder in Stratus’ success. This environment offers endless career opportunities for individuals with a commitment to customer service, focus on execution and bias for action.

Job Summary:
The Project Manager supports the Account Manager by developing and implementing comprehensive project plans for sign design, manufacturing, and installation, while meeting budget and gross margin targets. This role collaborates closely with internal departments—such as Art, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Production Control—to ensure projects are executed accurately, efficiently, and on schedule. Additionally, the Project Manager selects and manages subcontractors, negotiates pricing, oversees installation quality, and prepares final billing packages for approval.

Responsibilities

Project Development

Attend initial customer meetings alongside sales and Account Management teams to clarify location requirements, product specifications, design considerations, and preliminary surveys.
Collaborate with the Art and Engineering departments to produce initial artwork and develop production approaches.
Incorporate project scope, pricing parameters, and relevant details into initial proposals or final bids for customer approval.
Establish and update the initial ERP database with project information.

Project Planning

Upon project award, finalize graphic and engineering drawings, product specifications, and project timelines.
Work with Production Control to confirm production schedules and expand the ERP database as needed.
Secure installation drawings from the Art Department and confirm billing and reporting procedures with the customer.
Obtain necessary customer approvals and solicit competitive bids from subcontractors, negotiating installation pricing within budget and gross margin guidelines.

Project Execution

Review preliminary and technical surveys to define specific sign locations and finalize installation plans.
Obtain customer approvals and completion photos for billing, initiate Control Orders, and prepare comprehensive billing packages for Account Manager review.
Monitor accounts receivable, coordinate with Accounting/Credit teams to address delinquencies, and maintain an up-to-date ERP database with all project information.

Additional Duties

Perform other tasks as assigned by management to support overall company objectives and deliver high levels of customer satisfaction.

Qualifications

Skills and Competencies

Proficiency in English (reading, writing, speaking) is required; additional language skills are advantageous.
Ability to read, interpret, and communicate complex technical documents, business reports, and industry regulations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present information to managers, customers, and the public.
Solid mathematical skills, including geometry, trigonometry, fractions, percentages, ratios, and basic statistical concepts.
Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and experience using database and spreadsheet applications. Familiarity with computer-based project tracking tools is highly preferred.
Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with a focus on detail, accuracy, and meeting deadlines.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education and experience required, preferably in Business, Project Management, Engineering, Architecture, or Design.
1-3 years of project management experience in a multi-state or regional environment is required; experience in sign manufacturing, construction trades, or related industries is highly preferred.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams (Project Management, Sales, Production, Finance/Accounting, MIS) and external subcontractors.

Physical and Mental Demands

Primarily an office-based role with typical office duties (sitting, standing, walking, typing, filing).
Ability to lift packages up to 25 pounds occasionally.

Working Conditions

The primary work environment is a general office setting with moderate noise levels.
Some travel may be required to customer sites or installation locations, which may involve overnight stays and varying environmental conditions.

Why Work With Us

Supportive & Friendly Culture
Manage national accounts for Fortune 500 companies
Medical, Dental, Vision coverage options
Flexible Spending & Health Savings Accounts
Company paid Life Insurance
401k with Employer Contribution
Company paid Short/Long Term Disability
Generous Paid Time Off program + Holidays
Career Growth Opportunities and Career Mapping
Additional perks including Pet Insurance, Employee Assistance Program, Educational Assistance Program, Identity Theft Protection, Critical Illness Plans, Commuter Benefits and various employee discount offerings from our Vendors

Pay Range

$55,000- $70,000 annually - Pay range listed reflects the potential pay for this role. The pay will depend on various factors, such as responsibilities of the position, job duties/requirements, and relevant experience and skills. Not all positions posted will have a pay range listed.

Clinical Project Manager (CNS/Rare Disease) - Hybrid or Remote

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

Overview

As a Clinical Project Manager at ICON, you will be a true cross functional project manager. As a key leader within project delivery, the Project Manager oversees the planning, execution, and completion of global clinical projects, ensuring seamless collaboration across cross-functional teams. The role is accountable for project performance, resource optimization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery of high-quality outcomes aligned with ICON standards and client expectations. This particular role sits within our CNS ICON Biotech Team. Whilst experience of working with biotech clients is ideal it is not essential. CRO experience essential. Multiple EU locations can be considered with the option of Hybrid or remote working depending on location.

What You Will Do

Your focus will be on coordinating project and program management delivery, resolving issues, and developing team capability.

Key Responsibilities Include

Developing and managing detailed clinical project plans, including timelines, budgets, and resource allocation to ensure successful project delivery.
Leading cross-functional project teams, coordinating efforts to meet project objectives, and facilitating effective communication and collaboration.
Monitoring project progress, identifying potential risks and issues, and implementing strategies to address challenges and keep projects on track.
Engaging with stakeholders to manage expectations, provide updates, and ensure alignment with project goals and organizational objectives.
Preparing and presenting project reports, status updates, and performance metrics to senior management and other stakeholders.

Your Profile

You will have solid project and program management experience, with the ability to manage competing priorities and develop your team.

Required Qualifications And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in life science, project management, business, or related fields
Minimum of 7 years of clinical research experience or proven competencies for this position and a minimum of 2 years of direct global clinical project management experience
Clinical Project management experience from CRO or Biotech company highly preferred
Proven track record of successfully managing clinical projects from inception to completion, with a focus on delivering results within scope, time, and budget constraints.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and manage stakeholder expectations.
CNS/Rare Disease indication experience preferred
Willingness to travel as required (approximately 30%)

Senior Project Manager, Infrastructure

Why WWT?

World Wide Technology (WWT) strives to make a new world happen. WWT's work benefits clients and partners as much as it does its people and community across the globe.

Founded in 1990, WWT brings together strategy, deep technical expertise and world class partnerships to help public and private sector organizations design, build and scale intelligent AI, digital, cybersecurity, cloud and infrastructure solutions. Through its Advanced Technology Center (ATC)—a collaborative ecosystem featuring state-of-the-art hardware and software—WWT enables clients and partners to conceptualize, test and validate innovative technology and then deploy solutions at scale using its global integration and distribution capabilities.

With more than 14,000 team members and over 60 locations globally, WWT's culture—grounded in core values and leadership philosophies—has been recognized by Fortune® and Great Place to Work for its commitment to innovation, trust and creating a great place to work for all. WWT provides products and services to large enterprise, global service provider and public sector clients in up to 130 countries across six continents. Softchoice, a World Wide Technology company, supports commercial and SMB markets in the U.S. and Canada.

Want to work with highly motivated individuals on high-performance teams? Join WWT today!

What is the Solutions Consulting & Engineering (SC&E) Team and why join?

Solutions Consulting & Engineering is an organization that is Customer Focused and Solutions Led. We deliver end-to-end (E2E) and emerging solutions to drive customer satisfaction, increase profitability and growth. Our success is enabled by our world-class management consulting, delivery excellence and engineering brilliance. We embody the One WWT mindset by bringing the right talent at the right time from anywhere within WWT to solve our customers’ problems. Our goal is to bring together business acumen with full-stack technical know-how to develop innovative solutions for our clients' most complex challenges.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead and coordinate a large scale program. This individual will serve as a critical point of contact between internal teams and client stakeholders, ensuring that delivery, implementation, and operational excellence align with strategic objectives. Communication and relationship building is key. You’ll play a pivotal role in managing end-to-end delivery and services across multi-functional teams in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.

Responsibilities:

Manages the day-to-day operational and tactical aspects of multiple and large complex projects with multiple work streams
Ability to create in depth WBS with interdependencies and a defined critical path
Demonstrates excellent verbal and written communication skills; Develop and execute an efficient internal and external communication strategy for ensuring communication with all levels of management within the team
Monitor and report on project progress to stakeholders
Build and strengthen relationships with the customer and stakeholders (internal and external)
Responsible for creation and maintenance of resource plans ensuring effective resource allocation and distribution across portfolio of projects
Utilize project management tools and techniques to improve execution and drive efficiencies.
Implements engagement review and quality assurance procedures in accordance with our methodology
Ensure profitable and successful execution of all assigned engagements as measured by regional goals and customer feedback
Proactively manage changes in project scope
Effectively create and execute risk management plans
Manage and analyze profitability, revenue, margins, bill rates and utilization across projects
Understand and manage key project financial components to ensure projects are delivered within budget
Responsible for quality and timely execution of deliverables across projects

,

10+ years of experience as a Technical Infrastructure Project Manager
Experience in a Professional Services or Managed Services environment is required (critical: must have led external customer facing projects, not internal operational projects)
Networking, Storage, Virtualization, Cloud, Security, or Collaboration (Unified Communications) Project Management experience required
Multisite deployment experience (Wireless, Wi-Fi, POS, etc.)
Knowledge of both the theoretical and practical aspects of project management
PMP certification is desired
Understanding of financial processes; ability to understand, analyze and create financial reports preferably in Clarity
Extensive experience with people management, strategic planning, and change management

Understanding of and the ability to utilize the process of stakeholder analysis
Ability to work independently and aggressively track to project timelines
Excellent documentation skills and attention to detail
Ability to communicate well with customers and co-workers
Experience in effectively influencing and leading personnel and the ability to write business reports in a well-organized manner
Strong team building skills
Excellent problem solving, and critical thinking skills
Demonstrated communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation)
Proficiency with project management software

At Gist, we're proud to be part of the M&S Group, the logistics engine behind M&S Food.

From our distribution centres to our transport operations and support functions, we connect people, technology and expertise to ensure the right products reach the right stores at the right time.

As we continue to invest in our people, technology and network, there's never been a more exciting time to join Gist and help shape the future of food logistics.

The Opportunity

Our Technology team have exciting opportunity for an experienced Senior Project Manager where you will take ownership of large-scale critical projects driving the delivery of the programmes from site completion, operational readiness, migration and the implementation of automated mechanisation.

As the integration lead you will ensure collaboration and connectivity between the business, technology, engineering, operations, suppliers and delivery partners to ensure everything comes together safely on time and with clear accountability.

What You'll Be Doing

Reporting to the Senior Head of Programme Integration, you will:

Own the integrated delivery plans, driving milestones, dependencies, risks, critical path and outcomes.
Lead site completion, readiness, migration, cutover, testing, training and go-live.
Integrate technology, WMS, engineering and mechanisation delivery into the wider programme.
Provide clear governance, reporting and escalation to senior stakeholders.
Coordinate multiple teams, suppliers and delivery partners, holding to accountable for desired outcomes.
Drive safe, controlled implementation through stabilisation, handover and benefits realisation.
Ensure delivery is controlled across time, cost, quality, risk and change.
Support the Senior Head of Programme Integration with any additional tasks.

What We're Looking For

To be successful in your application you will be a confident project leader, someone who thrives in connecting operations, technology, engineering and suppliers’ teams with an objective focused and curious mindset. You will be able to demonstrate a proven track record in:

Leading complex, cross-functional projects and implementations, ideally within a 3PL, logistics & supply chain, or FMCG environment.
Experienced in migration, cutover and business continuity planning.
Knowledgeable in WMS, automation, technology or engineering integration.
Strong project controls across RAID, planning, cost, change, dependencies and governance.
Comfortable managing suppliers and senior stakeholders with confidence.
Able to turn complex delivery challenges into clear actions and outcomes.
Certified in PRINCE2, APM, Agile or similar qualifications are desirable.

This is a hands-on delivery leadership role where your ability to bring people, technology and operations together will directly shape successful implementation. If you are an experienced delivery leader who brings structure, pace and accountability we would like to hear from you!

Role Details

Salary: Up to £81,000 per annum (DOE)

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm.

Location: This role can be based anywhere in the UK, however individuals must be comfortable with travel across the UK.

What’s in it for you?

As Well As a Competitive Salary, You'll Benefit From

20% M&S discount on most things from furniture, fashion and food
25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays (rising with length of service)
Discounted rates on healthcare cash plan
Attractive annual bonus scheme, based on M&S performance and personal objectives
Auto Enrolment Pension or competitive Defined Contribution Pension Scheme and life assurance (up to 4 times salary)
Amazing perks and discounts via our App to major restaurants and retailers
Access to a wide range of wellbeing support – including our Employee Assistance Programme
A first-class welcome with a tailored induction and a wide range of training schemes to help with your learning and development
Cycle to work scheme

Why Gist?

When you join Gist, you're joining a business that plays a critical role within the M&S Group.

You'll have the opportunity to influence meaningful change, work alongside experienced leaders and contribute to one of the UK's leading food supply chains.

Our culture is built around our values of being Progressive, Accountable, Collaborative and Ethical, creating an environment where people are trusted, supported and encouraged to grow.

Whether you're leading a site operation, delivering transformation or shaping future strategy, your work will make a real difference.

Our commitment to inclusion

At Gist, we believe our differences make us stronger.

We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to succeed. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

The Senior NPI Project Manager plays a critical role in accelerating revenue growth by leading the successful introduction and launch of new products into Creation Technologies' manufacturing operations. Serving as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the New Product Introduction process, this individual will drive NPI programs from initiation through successful production launch while ensuring alignment across Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Operations, and other cross functional teams.

This role requires a highly organized and proactive project leader who can effectively manage multiple priorities, anticipate and resolve challenges, and maintain clear communication with both customers and internal stakeholders. The Senior NPI Project Manager will be responsible for coordinating cross functional activities, managing timelines and deliverables, identifying and mitigating risks, and ensuring new programs transition efficiently into manufacturing.

The preferred location for this position is Creation Technologies' Dallas, Texas facility, with Albuquerque, New Mexico; Boise, Idaho; and Rochester, New York also available as potential locations. While an onsite presence is preferred given the collaborative and manufacturing focused nature of the role, we are open to considering a remote work arrangement for the right candidate.

Experience within the Aerospace and Defense industry is strongly preferred, particularly experience managing complex NPI programs within an electronics or manufacturing environment. Due to the programs and customers this position may support, candidates must also be able to meet applicable ITAR and export control requirements.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include, but not limited to:

Develop comprehensive launch strategies, timelines, and cost estimates for high complexity, strategic new product launches to ensure they are executed on schedule, within budget, and with minimized risk.
Coordinate all NPI deliverables to customers, managing launch activities and associated risks to achieve seamless program execution.
Facilitate NPI Stage Gate reviews to confirm program readiness, validate key deliverables, and align cross-functional teams with stage objectives.
Serve as the primary customer liaison to communicate project status, scope changes, and key performance indicators, ensuring transparency and trust throughout the program launch.
Develop strong customer relationships by anticipating needs, responding quickly to issues, and fostering collaboration.
Lead customer and senior management meetings to present executive summaries, action plans, and readiness reviews that drive informed decision-making.
Drive adherence to the LEAP NPI process and champion continuous improvement to enhance efficiency and standardization.
Strategize with operations and engineering leadership to align priorities, balance resources, and achieve critical program deliverables.
Present NPI performance updates to executive leadership to support strategic planning and reinforce alignment with business goals.
Mentor and guide other NPI Project Management team members, as well as deploy training to customer-focused teams to support effective project management and NPI.
Collaborate with global cross-functional team members to drive problem solving and process improvements.
Report KPIs and NPI status to site, regional, and executive stakeholders to ensure alignment.
Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Education And Required Experience

Possess a Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in design, operations, management or engineering of various disciplines
Minimum 6 years electronic assembly experience or equivalent manufacturing experience
Prior NPI and transfer process experience is a must
Experience in managing projects using a stag-gate methodology
Aerospace and Defense, AS9100 experience an asset
Hands on technical capabilities with strong knowledge of assembly processes

Skills Required

Strong project management skills, including risk management, schedule development, and the ability to effectively get results from team members located in various sites within a geographical region.
Results driven and able to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
Excellent problem-solving skills, leadership, and team management capabilities
Effective communication and interpersonal skills to interact effectively with all levels of the organization as well as directly with key customer contacts in written, verbal, and presentation form.
Demonstrated experience with manufacturing best practices such Lean, 5S, Kaizen, etc. is an asset
Strong computer skills required: Experience in using an ERP or MRP system (Oracle is preferred), Project Management software, Excel, and Word.
Project Management Professional Certification preferred.

In accordance with pay transparency regulations, the anticipated starting salary for this position ranges from $120-$140k USD annually. Full-time employees are also eligible for performance-based bonuses and a range of benefits. Please note that this salary range is not guaranteed, and the final offer may vary based on experience, education, location, and shift. Additionally, the benefits and programs available may differ depending on the hire date, schedule type, and hours worked.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Governance Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Lead Bank

Lead is a banking infrastructure platform trusted by the most innovative companies to power complex financial products. We enable fintechs to offer compliant, programmable services like payments, lending, and digital assets at scale. Banking has moved beyond traditional institutions and is now embedded directly into everyday experiences, meaning companies need modern infrastructure that is safe, secure, and operationally sound.

Today, Lead is one of the only API-first, developer-focused partner banks with the financial, regulatory, and legal expertise required to help fintechs succeed. We operate offices in San Francisco, Sunnyvale, and New York City, and an FDIC-insured bank in Kansas City.

Information Security Team at Lead

The Information Security team helps Lead stay nimble enough to move fast without compromising on safety. They own cybersecurity, overseeing detection and response, and building security controls for all data networks, cloud infrastructures, and IT systems. Working closely with the Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams, they ensure Lead meets and stays up to date on all security standards. Scaling the systems that protect Lead and the fintechs we serve requires critical thinking, good judgment, and an ownership mentality. This is a collaborative team of builders who approach problems creatively, constantly iterating to improve the security of our platform.

Role Description

Lead Bank is seeking a Senior Security Technical Governance Program Manager to lead the strategy, execution, and continuous optimization of the bank’s technology governance, compliance, and risk programs. This role will be responsible for ensuring that security controls across the bank’s technology environment, internal operations, and Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) ecosystem meet rigorous regulatory requirements, industry standards, and internal risk tolerance.

The Senior Technical Governance Program Manager will play a critical role in standardizing security compliance processes, driving continuous monitoring, and embedding automated security controls into everyday operations. This position will partner closely with Security Engineering, Technology, Data, Compliance, and Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) teams to modernize control frameworks, maintain constant audit readiness, and safely govern emerging technologies across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and manage enterprise technology governance, risk, compliance, and control initiatives across Information Security, Technology, Engineering, and Data organizations.
Lead, mentor, and develop team members, including setting priorities and goals, providing ongoing coaching and feedback, and supporting professional growth and performance.
Drive enterprise Data Management and Governance initiatives, including data security, data classification, retention, data quality, governance controls, and regulatory compliance requirements.
Lead governance and readiness programs for enterprise Disaster Recovery (DR), including readiness assessments, control reviews, tabletop exercises, recovery testing, lessons learned, and resiliency improvement initiatives.
Manage Security Compliance programs across Information Security, Technology, and Engineering teams, ensuring alignment with applicable regulatory requirements, industry frameworks, internal policies, and security best practices.
Manage and oversee the enterprise Security Third-Party Risk Program, including risk assessments, due diligence, ongoing monitoring, control reviews, audits, issue management, and remediation tracking.
Drive automation of audit and compliance evidence gathering, control monitoring, and governance workflows to improve efficiency, consistency, audit readiness, and control effectiveness.
Lead coordination of internal and external audits covering technology, cybersecurity, cloud, engineering, infrastructure, and related controls. Manage evidence collection, lead control walkthroughs, audit requests, findings, and remediation activities through closure.
Support and lead strategic initiatives and special projects including but not limited to emerging technology risk, Artificial Intelligence (AI) governance and risk management, compliance program enhancements, automation, regulatory readiness, and technology control modernization.
Identify opportunities to strengthen technology governance and compliance through automation, continuous monitoring, risk-based controls, standardized processes, and scalable program improvements.
Perform all other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

5–8 years of experience in Technology, Information Security, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Technology Risk, Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), or a related discipline.
Experience managing, mentoring, and developing teams, with demonstrated ability to set priorities, provide feedback, and drive individual and team performance.
Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional technology governance, risk, compliance, or security programs in high-growth technology, fintech, startup, or similarly fast-paced environments.
Experience in banking, financial services, or other highly regulated industries preferred.
Familiarity with AI tools, AI governance, AI risk management, and emerging technology controls.
Strong understanding of technology governance, cybersecurity frameworks, cloud platforms, infrastructure security, engineering controls, technology risk, enterprise risk management, and compliance practices.
Experience working with internal and external auditors and managing remediation activities from identification through closure.
Demonstrated ability to automate, streamline, or modernize compliance, governance, risk, and audit evidence processes.
Experience developing governance metrics, executive reporting, risk assessments, control frameworks, or compliance dashboards.
Strong program management, stakeholder management, communication, organizational, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Ability to operate effectively across technical and non-technical teams and translate complex technology, security, risk, and compliance concepts into actionable business outcomes.

What We Offer

At Lead, we design our benefits to support company culture and principles , to foster an efficient and inspiring work environment, and to create the conditions for our team to give their best in both work and life

Competitive compensation based on experience, geographic location, and role
Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, 401k Matching, and other wellness benefits, including FSA, HSA and HRA
Paid parental leave
Flexible vacation policy, including PTO and paid holidays
A fun and challenging team environment in a dynamic industry with ample opportunities for career growth
Lead Bank is proud to have an inclusive culture committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity in all employment decisions regardless of race, color, gender, national origin, religion, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, military status, veteran status or any other legally protected status.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. Pay is based on a number of factors and may vary depending on geographical market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Zone 1: $176,400 - $206,168 (SF/Bay Area, NYC, Seattle)

Zone 3: $147,692 - $172,615 (Other US Metros)

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager – Global Cloud & Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About The Opportunity

The Technical Program Management Office (TPMO) is a strategic function within the Technology Innovation & Strategic Operations (TISO) department. Our mission is to accelerate WEX’s product delivery and innovation velocity across all technology domains. In this infrastructure-focused role, you will partner closely with systems, networking, cloud, database, security, and operations teams to align and execute critical infrastructure initiatives. In this remote, Brazil-based role, you will lead end-to-end programs that are primarily focused upon infrastructure efforts across global regions. You will act as the primary program manager collaborating across North America, United Kingdom, Brazil, and India time zones to align execution across cross-functional teams.

How You'll Make An Impact

Technical Fluency:
Lead complex infrastructure programs involving cloud migrations, data center operations, network architecture improvements, server lifecycle management, and database platform modernization. Efforts will span across North America, United Kingdom, Brazil, and India teams.
Collaborate with infrastructure architects, cloud engineers, database administrators, and network specialists to define program scope, milestones, risks, and success criteria.
Drive detailed work breakdown structures, execution plans, and multi-quarter roadmaps for infrastructure initiatives.
Oversee programs that enhance cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), hybrid cloud environments, and on-premise data center operations to ensure scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency.
Partner with cloud engineering teams to ensure seamless migration, deployment, and operational readiness of cloud services.
Coordinate efforts across network engineering and security teams to implement and maintain robust, scalable network infrastructure supporting business continuity and compliance requirements.
Manage dependencies related to firewall configurations, VPNs, load balancing, and network monitoring tools.

Program Planning/Continuous Planning: Based on Product and Technology leadership direction and priorities, facilitate ongoing planning sessions to adjust priorities and ensure continuous alignment with business goals within and across your portfolio. This will require close cross-functional partnership with technology team leaders, solution architects, and product partners. Ensure alignment of program increments with overall business goals and priorities. Encourage adaptive planning to respond to changing delivery and project requirements.
Program Management: Own and drive end-to-end technical implementation programs and workstreams as assigned. Your work will be critical to creating operational efficiencies within the Technical Program Management Office and Global Technology to execute against several key strategic projects. You’ll create detailed work breakdowns, milestones, risks, success metrics, and deliverables for key initiatives in these areas, and execute multi-quarter roadmaps in partnership with engineering leadership. On an ongoing basis, plan, support and execute against a roadmap of enhancements to these systems, tools, and processes.
Execution Management: In support of the Tech Lead, monitor progress and recommend necessary adjustments to surface risks of program execution to key stakeholders in a targeted and timely way, with the goal of course correction. Facilitate these course corrections, as needed.
Stakeholder and Change Management: Engage with stakeholders - Technology, Product, Solution Architecture, among others - at all levels to ensure visibility, provide updates, and address concerns. Facilitate communication between teams, ensuring transparency and alignment in fluent English. Provide clear, consistent, and timely information flow and reports out on status. Work collaboratively at the enterprise level to facilitate migrations and enable change to support new ways of working and modern technology architectures.
Risk Management: Identify technical risks related to infrastructure performance, capacity, security, and compliance. Develop mitigation strategies with technical and leadership partners. Escalate to senior leadership as appropriate.

Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com .

Role Summary

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to serve as the technical subject-matter expert (SME) for the Trust and Assurance team. This role will be responsible for leading the technical side of the compliance automation function of the team. A core part of the role is analyzing controls within the GRC platform to ensure they are accurate, meet framework requirements, and pull the necessary evidence to prove effectiveness. You will also partner with engineering teams to embed compliance into their workflows from the start. Strong compliance framework knowledge, solid program-management skills, and experience with AI technology are essential.

What You Will Do

Serve as the team's technical authority.

Manage compliance stack.

Oversee control mapping, evidence collection, and monitoring workflows, and manage the integrations that connect the GRC platform to cloud platforms and internal systems.

Establish control monitoring. Translate technical controls into automated, continuous checks, expanding monitoring coverage across the compliance stack and replacing manual reviews with ongoing monitoring.
Reduce audit burden.

Ensure every control has an accountable owner, support gap assessments and the rollout of new frameworks, and keep controls in a continuously audit-ready state.

Embed compliance into engineering.

Partner with engineering teams to build compliance requirements into their workflows and processes from the start, so compliance is designed in rather than added later.

Drive delivery and keep stakeholders aligned.

Manage initiatives through to completion, and communicate compliance risk, control status, and program progress to technical and non-technical audiences through clear, actionable summaries.

What You Will Bring

4+ years in GRC, compliance, or a technical role supporting cybersecurity programs, including leading programs and guiding or mentoring others.
Strong program and project management skills, with a track record of delivering across multiple teams.
Solid knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks (NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and/or FedRAMP) and hands-on audit experience.

Hands-on experience with a GRC or compliance-automation platform (e.g., LogicGate, ServiceNow, Drata), and comfort using AI tools in compliance workflows.
Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate between compliance and engineering for both technical and leadership audiences.
Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Experience building AI/ML-powered or agentic applications, and with API integrations, CI/CD pipelines, or deploying production-grade services.
Technical background in systems administration, software engineering, cloud security, or security engineering.

jobs.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

Fermi America is seeking a DC Commercial Program Manager. This position sits on Fermi’s Commercial Team, not in the DC construction organization, and serves as the delivery voice inside tenant pursuits. Fermi sells powered land, powered shell, and turnkey data centers, in tenancies measured in hundreds of megawatts and billions of dollars. This role makes sure that what Fermi offers a prospect is something Fermi can actually deliver, at the capacity offered, on the dates offered, under the terms offered, whichever product the deal lands on.

Capacity dates, service levels, demarcation of responsibility, and delivery obligations are set during pursuit and negotiation, and they bind for the life of the agreement. This role validates each of those commitments against the delivery plan before Fermi agrees to them.

The role works across every active pursuit and the pipeline behind it. It owns the campus capacity and availability position used in commercial conversations, the delivery basis behind each offer, the coordination of technical and lender diligence, and the handoff into the delivery organization once an agreement executes.

This role reports to the Head of DC Service & Delivery and sits within Fermi’s Commercial organization under the Chief Commercial Officer. It works closely with the DC delivery organization, Program Controls, and counsel to assemble and defend the delivery position behind each pursuit.

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the delivery voice inside tenant pursuits across all three Fermi products, powered land, powered shell, and turnkey, translating prospect requirements into a deliverable posture with the cost, schedule, and risk implications of each
Own the campus capacity and availability position used in commercial conversations, including megawatts by building, energization dates, and uncommitted capacity
Develop and maintain the delivery basis behind every commercial offer, including the schedule basis for a proposed ready-for-service date, the assumptions it depends on, and the conditions that would break it
Test proposed commercial terms against delivery reality before they are committed, including capacity dates, service levels, late delivery exposure, access rights, and demarcation, and identify what Fermi cannot credibly meet
Coordinate technical and commercial diligence for prospective tenants and for lender independent engineers, assembling input from technical, controls, construction, and operations
Build and maintain the standard pursuit package, including delivery approach, execution model, organization and staffing plan, schedule basis, and track record
Maintain the pipeline view and its delivery implications, identifying which pursuits would trigger staffing adds, long-lead procurement, or capacity conflicts if they close
Support lease and agreement negotiation from the delivery side, providing the basis for dates, obligations, and demarcation positions to counsel and the commercial organization, and identifying terms Fermi cannot deliver against before they are agreed
Own the pursuit-to-delivery handoff at execution, transferring the commercial commitments, delivery basis, assumptions, and open items to the accountable Director with named owners and dates
Track each active pursuit against the milestones that matter to delivery, including agreement execution, financial close, and notice to proceed, and the lead time each one triggers
Maintain the record of what Fermi has committed across executed agreements, so that new offers are made against remaining capacity and existing obligations
Route tenant technical requirement changes to the DC Sr Technical Manager for the technical position, and assess the commercial and schedule consequence of each
Provide delivery cost and schedule assumptions into commercial pricing models in coordination with Program Controls, so that pricing reflects the current delivery basis
Prepare pursuit and pipeline reporting for the Head of DC Service & Delivery and the Commercial Team, including status, delivery exposure, and required decisions
Capture lessons from each pursuit, won or lost, and update the standard pursuit package and delivery basis accordingly

AI-Enabled Execution Philosophy

Fermi America Integrates Artificial Intelligence And Advanced Analytics Into Its Core Project Delivery Workflows. The DC Commercial Program Manager Will Be Expected To Embrace And Champion This Philosophy, Including

Using AI to assemble diligence responses from prior submissions, technical documentation, and the program record
Applying AI-assisted analysis of tenant requirement documents, requests for proposal, and agreement drafts to identify obligations that carry delivery risk before they are agreed
Leveraging AI-driven comparison of proposed commercial terms against Fermi’s executed agreements to surface where a new deal diverges from precedent
Supporting a capacity and availability view drawn automatically from schedule and delivery source systems
Using AI to test consistency between commercial offers and the delivery plan of record
Contributing pursuit outcomes and lessons learned into Fermi’s standard pursuit package and delivery basis

Requirements

12+ years in commercial operations, solutions engineering, business development support, or program management within data center, energy, or large capital infrastructure, including at least 6 years in the data center industry
Demonstrated experience supporting large customer pursuits from qualification through agreement execution in a role accountable for the delivery position rather than for selling
Fluency across data center product types, including powered land, powered shell, turnkey, and build-to-suit, and a working command of how each shifts cost, schedule, and risk between owner and tenant
Ability to interrogate a construction schedule and a capacity plan, and to determine what commitments are credible
Experience coordinating technical and commercial diligence, including customer technical diligence and lender or independent engineer review
Familiarity with lease and services agreement structures, including capacity commitments, service levels, remedies, and demarcation of responsibility
Experience assembling a position across engineering, construction, controls, and operations without holding authority over any of them
Strong executive and customer-facing communication, credible in front of a prospective tenant and in front of Fermi leadership
Willingness to raise and defend a position that conflicts with commercial objectives, supported by schedule and capacity evidence
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business, or related field

Preferred Qualifications

Experience on the owner or developer side of hyperscale data center leasing, build-to-suit, or colocation
Familiarity with tenant technical requirement sets from hyperscale operators
Experience supporting project finance diligence and what lenders test in an owner’s ability to deliver
Experience with capacity planning and availability management across a multi-building campus
Working knowledge of Oracle Primavera P6 and enterprise delivery systems
Familiarity with AI-powered analytics and document review platforms
Comfort operating in a high-growth organization where the role will help define how pursuits are supported

Work Requirements

This role is based in Dallas or potentially a remote role with up to 60 percent travel, including tenant and partner offices, diligence sessions, industry events, and regular presence at Fermi’s campus in Amarillo, TX
Ability to host and participate in campus tours and site visits with prospective tenants, lenders, and partners, including walking active construction sites
Willingness to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE) including hard hat, safety glasses, high-visibility vest, steel-toe boots, and hearing protection when on-site
Flexibility to work extended hours during pursuit deadlines, diligence windows, and negotiation periods

jobs.description:
Description

What if your job was to prove that an AI-powered idea actually works - in weeks, not years - for the organisations that serve millions of people every day? We're looking for a Technical Program Manager who thrives at the intersection of generative AI, agentic systems, and real-world public sector challenges across Australia and New Zealand. You'll own the delivery of rapid engineering prototypes - most leveraging AI capabilities - that de-risk major technology investments for government agencies, healthcare systems, research institutions, and critical infrastructure providers.

This is a hands-on delivery role, not a coordination one. You will work side by side with software engineers and solutions architects to scope, plan, build, and ship AI-driven solutions that directly influence multi-million-dollar customer decisions. If you enjoy moving fast, applying generative AI and machine learning to real problems, making architecture and trade-off decisions alongside engineers, and seeing your work in production within weeks - not months - keep reading.

Key job responsibilities

Engagement Ownership

Own delivery of 2–4 concurrent engagements from qualification through build to customer handoff
Translate business problems into prototyping charters with defined outcomes, timelines, and exit criteria
Make architecture and design trade-offs alongside engineers - own the technical outcome, not just the schedule
Lead sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and execution across short build cycles

Pipeline & Qualification

Partner with sales and solutions architects to qualify opportunities against impact and feasibility
Lead Working Backwards workshops to define scope and success metrics

Reuse, Scale & Handover

Architect for reuse across customers, verticals, and geographies; plan handover with transfer artefacts and code drops
Collaborate globally (NAMER, UKGI) to share patterns and adapt solutions across regions

Regulated Environments

Navigate data sovereignty, health privacy, and government security requirements; clear compliance blockers for co-builds involving customer data

Stakeholder Navigation & Impact

Primary interface between customer, account team, and engineering - aligning sales priorities with technical feasibility
Connect prototype outcomes to investment decisions; surface reusable patterns for service teams

Technical Depth

Stay current on AWS AI/ML (Bedrock, SageMaker, agentic frameworks), serverless, and app modernization
Evaluate emerging GenAI, edge AI, and AI-assisted development patterns for public sector applicability

A day in the life

You ship working software - not slide decks. Engagements end with a prototype answering real customer questions.
Variety and pace - AI health assistants one month, legacy modernization the next, in weeks-long cycles.
Technical ownership - design trade-offs alongside engineers; you own the outcome.
Direct impact - prototypes inform multi-million-dollar decisions for organizations serving millions.
Small team, outsized reach - high-autonomy work visible to senior leadership.
Build once, amplify many - solutions reused across countries and showcased at AWS events.
Global team - collaborating across time zones to share patterns and raise the bar.

About The Team

A field-deployed AWS engineering team accelerating public sector outcomes through prototyping - with AI at the core. We build working systems that de-risk transformation programs and unlock cloud adoption for government organizations across Australia and New Zealand.

Work spans agentic AI, application modernization, edge AI, and AI-assisted development. Small teams on 1-6 week cycles demand sharp scoping and tight engineering-sales-SA collaboration. Solutions built to transfer, not maintain - co-built with customers, architected for reuse, handover designed from day one.

Aligned to health, transport, education, defence, and research, you build domain expertise across diverse technical problems.

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
3+ years of software development experience
5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience with AI/ML technologies

Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience implementing scalable compliance solutions (technology, procedures, processes, etc.) in a regulated environment
Experience working with Enterprise Application Modernization and Migration technologies, including, but not limited to, Mainframe, Serverless, Containers, or Cloud Operations
Experience with technology transformation initiatives

Background in public sector, government, healthcare, defence, or regulated industries

Experience with rapid prototyping, proof-of-concept delivery, or innovation lab environments

Demonstrated ability to design for reuse — building solutions that scale across multiple customers or use cases rather than single-purpose deliverables

jobs.description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

This position is for an Operational Security Manager in the Solutions Services Group (SSG). This is an exciting role that will give you the opportunity to work with Lenovo Engineering teams around the world to help Lenovo Business Units align with various regional, national and international security standards and regulations. You will be working alongside some of the best security teams in the industry. You will join a growing team of security professionals to protect and maintain the effectiveness of managed service capabilities.

The Operational Security Manager supports cybersecurity incident response, investigation, escalation, and regulatory reporting, with a focus on the EU Cyber Resilience Act. Working across Cybersecurity, Product Security, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Engineering, this role ensures incidents are properly assessed, documented, and reported within required timelines. The Operational Security Manager also provides technical leadership and continuously improves security processes, controls, and supporting technologies.

What You'll Be Doing

Support the full cybersecurity incident response lifecycle, including triage, investigation, containment, escalation, remediation, recovery, and post-incident review across enterprise and product environments.
Coordinate incident response activities across Cybersecurity, Product Security, Engineering, IT, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and external partners, including support for critical incidents outside normal business hours when necessary.
Assess incidents and actively exploited vulnerabilities affecting products marketed or sold in the EU to determine applicable handling and notification requirements, particularly under the EU Cyber Resilience Act.
Coordinate timely and accurate regulatory notifications, ensuring required incident, product, impact, mitigation, and remediation information is gathered, validated, documented, and communicated.
Maintain incident records, regulatory assessments, reporting decisions, evidence, and chain of custody in support of internal, legal, audit, and regulatory requirements.
Strengthen incident response readiness through playbooks, tabletop exercises, lessons learned, metrics, automation, and improvements to monitoring and investigation capabilities.

What You’ll Need

Significant experience leading cybersecurity incident response or security operations, with demonstrated knowledge of the full incident response lifecycle.
Experience investigating incidents across product, application, cloud, infrastructure, network, endpoint, and third-party environments.
Working knowledge of EU cybersecurity regulatory requirements, particularly the incident and actively exploited vulnerability notification requirements of the EU Cyber Resilience Act.
Strong understanding of threat and vulnerability analysis, digital forensics, evidence preservation, chain of custody, and technologies such as SIEM, endpoint security, threat intelligence, and vulnerability management platforms.
Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear incident assessments, escalation decisions, executive communications, and regulatory notifications.
Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage high-pressure incidents and meet operational and regulatory deadlines.

What We Offer

An international team with a high focus on Gender Diversity.
Employee Assistance Program, e.g., for psychological, legal financial consultancy
You are joining a company that prioritizes sustainable solutions like CO2 Offset, Asset Recovery Services, and the Lenovo Certified Refurbished portfolio.
Access to training for personal development - Internal E-learning Development Platform Available for Employees
Mentorship program

jobs.title: Enterprise Vendor Program Manager III
jobs.description:
The Enterprise Vendor Program Manager III is a senior subject matter expert who leads the design and implementation of the global vendor management strategy. Reporting to the Manager of Enterprise Vendor Management, this position takes a lead role in developing and refining the governance programs that enable business teams to manage vendors effectively. The Program Manager III will drive initiatives across all five pillars of the vendor lifecycle—Risk, Performance, Sustainability & Diversity, Innovation & Automation, and Training—acting as a strategic advisor to the business and ensuring the frameworks, tools, and processes deliver maximum value and mitigate critical risks.

Essential Functions

Vendor Risk Management: Leads the design and continuous improvement of the enterprise vendor risk framework. Acts as a key advisor to business teams on the adoption of risk assessment tools and compliance management processes.
Vendor Performance Management: Drives the evolution of the vendor performance management framework. Designs and enhances standardized toolkits (KPI scorecards, QBR agendas) to ensure they meet the evolving needs of the business.
Sustainability and Diversity: Leads the strategic integration of corporate sustainability and diversity goals within the vendor lifecycle, developing innovative frameworks for Sourcing and Business teams to drive meaningful impact.
Innovation and Automation: Drives the identification and implementation of key technologies (e.g., AI, advanced automation) to strategically enhance and simplify vendor management processes, increasing enterprise-wide visibility and efficiency.
Training and Enablement: Leads the development of the overall training and enablement strategy. Designs comprehensive training programs and acts as a mentor to junior team members and business stakeholders on vendor management best practices.
Stakeholder Collaboration & Influence: Acts as a primary point of contact for senior stakeholders, using influence to drive the adoption and maturation of the enterprise vendor management program across the organization.
Process Improvement: Owns and drives significant process improvement roadmaps for the vendor management framework, delivering measurable gains in governance, quality, and efficiency.
Performs other duties as assigned.

Minimum Education

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business, supply chain, finance, or a related field.

Minimum Experience

Six (6) years of work experience in program/project management, business process design, vendor management governance, or business enablement.

Proven experience leading the rollout of enterprise-wide processes, training, or tools is required.

Prior exposure to procurement, sourcing, or supply chain environments is highly preferred. An advanced degree may offset some of the experience requirement.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Program & Process Enablement: Expert ability to design and implement complex, user-friendly frameworks and playbooks that drive adoption across a large enterprise.

Change Management & Training: Advanced skills in translating complex governance into strategic enablement programs and guiding senior stakeholders through significant process changes.

Strategic Influence: Exceptional interpersonal skills with a proven ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams and senior leaders without direct authority.

Analytical & Tool Aptitude: Deep understanding of how technology and reporting tools (like Power BI, Coupa, or risk platforms) can be leveraged to drive strategic process improvements for the business.

Preferred Qualifications:
This is a hybrid position located in Memphis, Plano or Pittsburgh. Candidates must live within 50 miles of the campus location. Employees will be required to work at the FedEx campus location several times per week.

to serve as the primary contractor point of contact for a federal agency client, coordinating all tasks, deliverables, and personnel across a multi-disciplinary IT support Blanket Purchase Agreement. jobs.title: Cybersecurity, Privacy and Forensics - Data Protection - PKI Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As a Cybersecurity, Privacy and Forensics - Data Protection - PKI Implementation Manager, you will specialize in providing advice and guidance to clients on privacy laws and data protection regulations. You will help businesses navigate the complex landscape of privacy and data protection requirements, confirming compliance with applicable laws and regulations. Working in this area, you will assist in developing privacy policies, conducting privacy impact assessments, and implementing data protection measures to safeguard personal information. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations.

In this role, you will be part of our Cybersecurity & Privacy network within our Cyber, Data & Tech Risk practice. You will embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way.

Responsibilities

Leading the implementation of Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) solutions to enhance data protection measures
Guiding clients through privacy laws and data protection regulations to confirm compliance with applicable standards
Conducting privacy impact assessments and developing comprehensive privacy policies
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to address cybersecurity challenges and data breach incidents
Analyzing system components to identify linkages and interactions for improved data security
Taking ownership of projects, managing planning, budgeting, execution, and completion phases
Coaching team members to leverage their strengths and deliver on client expectations
Engaging in strategic questioning to identify opportunities for enhancing privacy program development
Reviewing legal documents and providing legal advice to support compliance with data protection laws
Upholding professional and technical standards, including the firm's code of conduct and independence requirements

What You Must Have

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 4 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Analytics/Data Science, Business Administration/Management, Communications/Media, Computer Science/Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Government/Public Policy, Law/Legal Studies, Mathematics/Statistics, Project/Technology Management, Risk Management/Insurance, Marketing
Demonstrating proficiency in cybersecurity and privacy regulations
Utilizing analytical thinking to solve complex data protection challenges
Excelling in coaching and mentoring team members
Developing privacy program strategies for client engagements
Embracing change and innovation in data risk management
Navigating legal compliance in data protection and privacy

jobs.description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About The Team

Workday's Product & Technology (P&T) PMO organization is responsible for leading and executing P&T Strategy into Execution. The team is responsible for End to End Program execution and delivery of strategic initiatives across Workday. The team comprises of Program Managers with core responsibility of successfully leading & delivering of Portfolio and Programs.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Sr. Program Manager to join Workday's Product & Technology (P&T) Portfolio Management Organization to lead Cyber Security related programs across Workday.

The ideal candidate is an enthusiastic self-starter and proactive problem-solver who is capable of managing multiple complex projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams, driving standardization, and communicating with executive stakeholders. This is a great opportunity to drive innovation, maturity and standardization across Workday!

Key Responsibilities

Collaborate with cross-functional teams and executives to ensure alignment and execution of plans.
Proactively identify roadblocks and mitigate risks.
Drive process standardization and continuous improvement.
Facilitate key meetings and workshops.
Regularly provide executive-level briefings, including key performance indicators, milestones, risk mitigation plans, and key decisions.

About You

Basic Qualifications:

8+ years experience in project or program management within a product development environment, defining, launching, and iterating on product development projects or programs.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline such as Business, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Other Qualifications:

Deep understanding of Agile Project Management principles and methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe and proven ability to lead agile transformations and drive efficient product development.
Strong ability to gather and interpret Business Insights related to product performance, market trends, and competitive analysis to inform strategic product decisions.
Strong Decision Making skills in complex product-related matters, balancing user needs, technical feasibility, and business goals within Objective & Key Results (OKRs) and effectively communicating rationale and potential impacts.
Strong Interpersonal Intelligence skills, effectively communicating, collaborating, and influencing cross-functional team members and stakeholders at various levels.
Solid understanding of Leading Change principles and the ability to lead and facilitate Cyber Security & Trust focused charters within product development organizations.
Good working knowledge of Process Improvements methodologies and proven ability to identify and implement optimizations within product development workflows.

Workday Pay Transparency Statement

The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here.

Primary Location Base Pay Range: $168,700 USD - $253,100 USD

Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $142,500 USD - $253,100 USD

Additional Considerations:

If performed in Colorado, the pay range for this job is $150,000 - $225,000 USD based on min and max pay range for that role if performed in CO.

The application deadline for this role is the same as the posting end date stated as below:

10/02/2026

Our Approach to Flexible Work

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field
with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

Piloter le projet depuis la phase de lancement jusqu'à la clôture et bilan
Planifier, organiser et suivre les activités de votre équipe

Assurer la qualité des livrables et interfacer le service qualité
